Team —

Following our Friday close-plan sync, I sketched a lightweight liaison grid to capture: primary executive champion, alternate, suggested ask for each meeting, and the recommended Boardroom/EB attendee list. I attached Acme_MAP_v1.pdf and a proposed_meeting_rhythm.xlsx as the starting point.

Goals for this thread:
- Agree who at Redwood will own each liaison relationship (O: lead, C: cover)
- Lock 2x 45-min leadership sync windows for the final close week (target week of 09/13)
- Confirm pre-read packet and a single-sheet decision tracker we can circulate to the EB 48 hours before each sync

Quick asks:
1) Karthik — can you confirm whether Acme indicated CFO availability on the 14th in your last call?
2) Marcus — CS should own the tech deep-dive slot; can you propose two 30-min options we can offer?
3) Laura — can you surface if we should include a short SLAs slide for the EB pre-read?

I suggest we treat the liaison grid as the single source of truth and use the HubSpot deal link (below) for calendar invites so everything maps to the MA P and pipeline.

Attachments: Acme_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP draft), proposed_meeting_rhythm.xlsx (candidate slots), SOC2-extract-summary.pdf (for procurement comfort)
